name: AutoViVQA
description: Visual Question Answering (VQA) is a fundamental multimodal task that requires models to jointly understand visual and textual information. Early VQA systems relied heavily on language biases, motivating subsequent work to emphasize visual grounding and balanced datasets. With the success of large-scale pre-trained transformers for both text and vision domains -- such as PhoBERT for Vietnamese language understanding and Vision Transformers (ViT) for image representation learning -- multimodal fusion has achieved remarkable progress. For Vietnamese VQA, several datasets have been introduced to promote research in low-resource multimodal learning, including ViVQA, OpenViVQA, and the recently proposed ViTextVQA. These resources enable benchmarking of models that integrate linguistic and visual features in the Vietnamese context. reputation: A newer Vietnamese VQA benchmark that is useful for low-resource multimodal evaluation but is not yet broadly established as a standard leaderboard.
notes: VQA benchmarks can be sensitive to answer normalization and language-specific annotation quality; likely limited by dataset size and potential language/vision bias.
